CHANGES
Rain recordings were excerpted, crossfaded, EQ-filtered, stereo-width adjusted, layered and gain-mastered. Thunder recordings were trimmed, EQ-filtered, faded and gain-mastered; Distant_Long is a slowed/filtered variation of Medium_Roll. No hard limiter was used. All runtime WAVs were resampled to 48 kHz and exported as dithered 16-bit PCM.

SOURCE QUALITY
The window recording came from its original downloadable WAV. Ylmir rain came from the author-published 160 kbps Ogg files. Thunder came from public high-quality Freesound MP3 previews. WAV conversion does not restore lossy-source detail. Original downloads, 24-bit processing masters and separate rain stems are retained in the production workspace.


OPTIONAL CREDIT
Rain: Ylmir and alxl (OpenGameArt, CC0). Thunder: seth-m, cognito perceptu and TRP (Freesound, CC0). Indoor edit and layering prepared for Haunted Fish Hotel.
